prediction_text: Direction: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election — this is the call of the one identified Costa Mesa panel astrologer singled out on this card, the forecaster who had earlier, against a 17-candidate Republican field, picked Trump to become the Republican nominee. That demonstrated willingness to call Trump against consensus extends to the general election: Trump defeats Clinton on 8 November 2016 (timing coordinate: the election date on the card).
basis: The card has no tradition/system field; answered on its face as a mundane-astrology election judgment attributed to one specified forecaster. Card facts distinguishing this case from WP-004: the subject is not the panel as a body but the single panel astrologer who, earlier in the cycle when 17 Republicans still contested the nomination, picked Trump as the eventual nominee — a matter of record on the card. A forecaster whose signature call of the cycle was Trump's rise, made against the whole field, is read as holding that line into November: his judgment is for Trump to win the presidency. No natal charts are given on the card and none are invented; the delineation rests on the attribution the card itself supplies. The panel-consensus question is a different card (WP-004) and is not mixed into this one.
